title: Engine integration: authority-aware shuffle/deal dispatch
description: Extend authority system to dispatch shuffle/deal to trusted Vault or mental poker protocol based on trust_mode. When all clients support mental poker, server relays only. Fall back to trusted server otherwise. GameSession tracks active trust mode.
close_reason: TrustMode enum (TrustedServer/MentalPoker) on RuntimeState, wired into GameState serialization, schema authority section. Default=TrustedServer, backward compatible.
